methodology: Freeze the human close-reading and winner-selection rules before any GPT-5.6 candidate call. Review all twelve new source-candidate pairs under opaque identifiers, with candidate model, document identity, detector result, route, latency, and price hidden until a canonical review artifact containing every verdict and cited finding is committed to git. Only that committed artifact may be finalized and revealed. This is a deliberately difficult six-document development canary selected from the already-frozen Codex review of the Qwen reference, not a new holdout and not confirmatory evidence.

selectionRationale.firstFour: all four documents classified major in the frozen Qwen close reading

blinding.opaquePairOrder: Sort SHA-256 of UTF-8 model-canary-v7|candidateModel|documentId, then assign MCV7-01 through MCV7-12. The runner validates and later reveals the mapping.

comparisonCriteria.lostClaims: Flag a proposition, qualification, instruction, conclusion, or rhetorical commitment present in the source but absent from the candidate.
comparisonCriteria.addedClaims: Flag a proposition, rationale, implication, recommendation, or qualification introduced without source support.
comparisonCriteria.changedClaims: Flag altered predicates, relationships, conditions, comparisons, definitions, temporal claims, or conclusions.
comparisonCriteria.numbersEntitiesExamples: Check every number, unit, date, named entity, role, quotation, example, list member, and concrete detail for preservation and correct attachment.
comparisonCriteria.causality: Check that causes, mechanisms, evidence, consequences, and correlations are neither substituted nor strengthened or weakened.
comparisonCriteria.negation: Check explicit and implicit negation, exceptions, exclusions, contrasts, and reversals.
comparisonCriteria.scopeCertaintyCaveats: Check quantifier and actor scope, modality, likelihood, confidence, hedging, limitations, conditions, and caveats.
comparisonCriteria.paragraphRoleOrder: Check whether each paragraph still performs its source role and whether reordering changes reference, emphasis, progression, or logic.
comparisonCriteria.exactStrings: Check strings whose exact surface form matters, including quotations, commands, identifiers, labels, filenames, URLs, code, symbols, and deliberate repetition.
comparisonCriteria.voice: Check speaker identity, stance, register, point of view, directness, and intentional rhetorical texture.

verdictScale.pass: No material fidelity issue. Wording, syntax, ordinary compression, and style changes are not errors when meaning, exact-value obligations, and voice remain equivalent.
verdictScale.minor: At least one localized material fidelity issue changes a secondary detail, nuance, caveat, emphasis, exact string, or voice without changing the central message or practical takeaway.
verdictScale.major: A material claim, conclusion, instruction, causal relationship, polarity, scope, key entity, number, example, paragraph function, or practical takeaway is lost, added, contradicted, or substantially changed.

findingRules: Every non-pass verdict must identify a fixed comparison criterion and cite paired source and candidate evidence.
Each sourceQuote must be an exact nonempty substring of that opaque pair's sourceText and each candidateQuote must be an exact nonempty substring of its candidateText.
Pass verdicts must have an empty findings list; non-pass verdicts must have at least one finding.
Mere wording or style change is never a finding by itself.
Each pair receives one overall verdict equal to its highest-severity material finding.
Pipeline failures are computed by code and are not silently repaired during review.
All twelve opaque verdicts must be committed before model and document mapping is revealed.

preRevealCommitment.reviewArtifactSha256: SHA-256 of the canonical review object with this field omitted; the committed file must match it byte-for-byte when canonicalized

candidatePassesOnlyIf.candidateOutputDetectorRole: descriptive only; never used to select or reject a six-document canary candidate

selectionRule.ifBothPass: select the candidate with lower actual provider cost; if exact Decimal cost ties, select lower total measured latency
selectionRule.ifNeitherPasses: stop without selecting a model and do not build the demo from this canary
